turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are tons of blackberries along my usual trail. Is it safe to eat them?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Blackberries are one of the safest wild fruits, since there's nothing toxic that looks similar.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My car insurance renewal just came in and it's gone up a lot.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's annoying. Do you want to shop around for a new quote, or call your insurer and ask them to match a better price?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, my friend and I need to figure something out. Wait until I'm back, okay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you know how long it takes to get downtown at nine in the morning?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: With traffic? At least forty minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh wow. My interview is at nine thirty.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then leave by eight, and grab a coffee nearby if you're early.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good idea. Can I borrow your nice umbrella too? It's supposed to rain.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Of course. Showing up soaked is not the look.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We'd got to the renewal price. Any decision?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Even ones right by the path?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Pick the ones higher up, away from where dogs might wander. Avoid bushes next to busy roads.
